%s

LeaveSafe yana mai da wayarka ƙararrawar kwamfutarka daga nesa. Gudanar da shi,
duba QR da yake nunawa, danna Kunna kariya, sannan ka tafi.

Amfani:
  leavesafe [flags]
  leavesafe <command>

Umarnai:
  install-service     Fara LeaveSafe da kansa lokacin shiga
  uninstall-service   Cire shigarwar farawa ta atomatik
  service-status      Nuna ko an saka shigarwar farawa ta atomatik

Zaɓuɓɓuka:
  -dev                Bayar da allon waya daga web/dist maimakon kwafin
                      da aka haɗa, don haɓakawa
  -plain              Buga layin kundi maimakon allon sarrafa cikakken taga,
                      bar layin umarni yadda yake. Ana zaɓarsa da kansa
                      idan an tura fitarwa zuwa fayil ko bututu
  -headless           Aiki ba tare da allon umarni ba, don farawa da kansa
  -managed            Manhajar LeaveSafe ta kwamfuta ta fara shi, ita ce take
                      ɗauke da wannan fayil tana zaɓar sigarsa. Wannan kwafin
                      ba ya binciken sabuntawa: manhajar ce take yi
  -version            Buga siga ka fita
  -h, -help           Nuna wannan taimakon

Muhalli:
  PORT                Sauya tashar sauraro da ke saituna

Fayiloli:
  %s
    config.json       Saituna, ana iya sauyawa daga waya ma
    events.jsonl      Tarihin abubuwan tsaro, ana juyawa da girma
    leavesafe.log     Kundin manhaja, ana juyawa da girma
    state.json        Ko kariya tana kunne lokacin tsayawa na ƙarshe
